incidentReports.log: Empowering students in game development, Unity, Blender, and computer science fundamentals. Leading projects for the upcoming Aptech Vision 2026 event.
Implemented psychological client outreach strategies and focused content delivery, expanding the company client base by 40%.
Managed end-to-end 3D asset production for a commercial FPS horror game. Delivered optimized, real-time props and environment art.
Engineered mobile game environments and interactive elements in Unity from initial concept blockouts to final lightmapping.
